left.title: iriscard pro business card scanner
left.description: the iriscard pro business card scanner is the most popular multilingual business card scanning solution and is ideal for individuals and both large and small companies. by quickly and easily scanning your business cards the iriscard pro can help you keep a record of all important contacts. convenient and versatile it synchronizes with pocket pcs and palm devices as well as outlook and outlook express. to help keep you organized the iriscard pro features a one-touch export button so you can send your contacts to your favorite electronic address book after scanning them. the iriscard pro is a multilingual business card scanning solution that is ideal for both large and small companies. view larger. the system utilizes cardiris software the iriscard organizer tool. view screenshots. iriscard works with a variety of email software packages. view screenshots. small and easy to use the iriscard pro offers reliable and incredibly easy operation. simply insert your business cards inside the unit and they will be instantaneously captured into your computer with precision. you can also export or synchronize the data with your electronic address book so it's a snap to access the exact information you need when you need it. the iriscard pro works with a variety of email software packages including outlook outlook express address book now contact and entourage. it also recognizes cards from up to 56 countries features eight user-interface languages (english french spanish italian portuguese german dutch and russian) and is usb powered so it's the ideal travel companion. where and when to use the iriscard pro compact light and portable the iriscard pro comes in handy at home in the office or on the road. at home the iriscard pro lets you keep your personal address book always up-to-date. it's also an efficient full-color usb-powered twain photo scanner that digitizes your 4 x 6 pictures with up to 600 dots per inch (dpi) resolution. and thanks to its ergonomic design it's much more comfortable to use than regular flatbed scanners. at the office you can rely on the iriscard pro to help minimize disorganized piles of business cards cluttering up your desk. since this device scans retypes and exports your contacts in just seconds they're instantly available to you rather than scattered all over your workplace. the iriscard pro also helps you out when you're away from your home or office. whether at trade shows conferences or other out-of-town events the iris card pro is the best tool to quickly store new contacts and follow up on all your leads. after your trip you can choose the album view function which shows either a multi-card display to quickly visualize scanned cards or a single card display to easily add notes or additional information. special operating features the iriscard pro uses bcr technology that combines i.r.i.s. ocr and field parsing technologies for accurate recognition and field matching. the system also utilizes cardiris the iriscard business card recognition software and organizer tool. thanks to the user-friendly interface and automatic orientation deskewing and cropping of the business cards you'll never have to struggle to get consistent high-quality results. to rapidly and accurately convert business cards into database records the iriscard also offers state-of-the-art field analysis while the zoom function lets you see every detail in each card. designed for ocr on the fly this scanner gives you the option to drag and drop names emails and websites directly in the right database fields or in any application. additionally the windows version is enhanced with a database and useful sort search and selection tools to increase your daily contact management what's in the box usoa307 iriscard business card scanner usb cable calibration card for the scanner software cd-rom (cardiris business card organizer software demo version of readiris pro ocr software goodcontacts) quick installation guide and registration card and user license.
